notes.subject: שבלול
notes.rationale: Snail — its only occurrence in the Tanakh; the picture of one dissolving in its own slime.

notes.subject: נפל אשת
notes.rationale: A woman's fallen thing: stillborn child (KJV/JPS) vs. some read plural 'untimely births'.

notes.subject: תמס יהלך
notes.rationale: Read by some as 'melting it goes' (snail) and by others as 'melting let it go' (imprecation against the wicked).

translation: A bɛ taa i n'a fɔ jɛgɛnsunnun min bɛ fɛlɛ ka bɔ a yɛrɛ la; muso den min tun ma se ka balo, o tɛ tile ye.

tokens.gloss: den min tun ma se ka balo
